Thanks for your support. You can use this citation function in R, citation(package = "jiebaR") to get the BibTeX format for citation. Hope that you will find it helpful.


You can also look at this page to see how other people cite packages on CRAN. http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/9781118763667.oth1/pdf


Best,
Wenfeng.
